facts.text: The Roadrunner Promise covers full remaining tuition and mandatory fees up to 15 credit hours per semester for eligible Colorado students from households earning $65,000 or less.

sources.title: The Roadrunner Promise - MSU Denver
sources.quote: The Roadrunner Promise (RRP) is our pledge to cover any remaining tuition and mandatory fees for eligible Colorado students after federal, state and institutional aid is applied.
